First principles: What it takes to be a great product manager in the AI era | Sherif Mansour Sherif Mansour on why PMs are thriving in the AI era, the artist PM advantage, and why juniors are your secret weapon now Lenny Rachitsky Nov 22, 2026 ∙ Paid 87 4 Share Transcript Sherif Mansour is Head of AI and Product Craft at Atlassian (the company behind Jira and Confluence), where he has spent 17 years building and scaling some of the most successful enterprise products in history. He joined Atlassian as its first PM on Confluence, eventually becoming its first Distinguished PM, and now leads both the craft of product management across the company and Atlassian’s AI product strategy. Listen on YouTube , Spotify , or Apple Podcasts We discuss: Why a PM’s #1 job is to build a “shared brain” The artist, the scientist, and the GM: three types of PM, and how to tell which one you are
